name: Rosbag2 Cloud Offload
purpose: Stream ROS 2 rosbag2 recordings off the robot into Backblaze B2, describe them from rosbag2's own metadata, and catalog every session in Parquet so any recording can be found and replayed with ros2 bag play from a presigned B2 URL.
tagline: Continuous rosbag2 offload, describe, and catalog on Backblaze B2 — bags off the robot, searchable and replayable.

features.title: Continuous Bag Offload
features.summary: Presigned-PUT each closed rosbag2 split into bags/<robot>/<session>/ while recording continues; local copies deleted only after head_object confirms.

features.title: Session Catalog & Search
features.summary: Parquet catalog keyed by robot, date, topic set and ROS distro; sample-scoped explorer over the bags/ namespace.

features.title: Bag Describe
features.summary: ros2 bag info when a ROS 2 env is present, else parse rosbag2 metadata.yaml; writes metadata.json and records compression sizes.

features.title: Replay via Presigned URL
features.summary: Presigned GET manifest streams a session's splits for ros2 bag play against B2.

features.title: Bucket Explorer
features.summary: Full-bucket browse across bags/ and catalog/, kept from the starter kit.

features.title: Offload Dashboard
features.summary: Offload volume, session count, and compression-ratio stats over the bags/ prefix.

b2_surface.why: Write each session's metadata.json and roll the Parquet catalog under catalog/.
Direct robot/browser upload of each closed bag split under bags/<robot>/<session>/.
Enumerate a session's splits and discover sessions under the bags/ prefix for the catalog.
Confirm a split landed before the watcher deletes the local copy, and read split sizes.
Read rosbag2 metadata.yaml and the Parquet catalog for describe and query.
Stream bag splits for ros2 bag play replay and download the catalog.
Delete a session's bags, scoped strictly to its bags/<robot>/<session>/ prefix.

stack.web: Next.js 16 (App Router, React 19, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query)

env_vars.name: B2_BUCKET_NAME
env_vars.note: Target B2 bucket for bags/ and catalog/.

env_vars.name: B2_REGION
env_vars.note: B2 region, e.g. us-east-005; endpoint is derived from it.

env_vars.name: B2_PUBLIC_URL_BASE
env_vars.note: Optional public base URL for objects served publicly.

env_vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
env_vars.note: Frontend override for the API base URL (dev/deploy).
